title: A Masterclass In Investing Frameworks with Gautam Baid - The Special Situations Report Episode #42
summary: Discovery, the widening spread on the deal, regulatory risks, and shareholder and management dynamics. reader_summary.overview: We’re proud to release this week’s special episode, an interview with our wonderful guest, Gautam Baid. Gautam is a CFA charterholder and the author of the international best-seller, The Joys of Compounding . Gautam is also the Managing Partner of Stellar Wealth Partners India Fund , a Delaware-based investment partnership which is available to accredited investors in the US.

key_points.text: Gautam is a CFA charterholder and the author of the international best-seller, The Joys of Compounding .
Our conversation with Gautam covered multiple fascinating topics – such as special situations like spinoffs in India.
We learned so much from this discussion, and we hope our listeners will too.
